name: Name
deleteConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this SSO provider?
deleteProviderDesc: This will permanently delete the SSO provider.
providerDeletedDesc: The SSO provider has been successfully deleted.
providerCreatedDesc: The SSO provider has been successfully created.
providerUpdatedDesc: The SSO provider has been successfully updated.
certificateHint: Provide the IdP signing certificate without BEGIN/END markers.
spSigningCertificateHint: Provide the SP certificate (without BEGIN/END markers) that the IdP should trust for signed AuthnRequests.
spSigningPrivateKeyHint: Paste the PEM encoded private key. It will be stored encrypted and is never shown again.
spSigningPrivateKeyHintExisting: Leave empty to keep the existing encrypted key. Provide a PEM file to rotate it.
signingMaterialsMissing: Signing AuthnRequests requires both a Service Provider certificate and private key.
setupInstructionsHint: Use the URLs below in your identity provider after saving this provider.
oidcRedirectUriDescription: Register this as the redirect/return URL in your IdP application.
samlAcsUrlDescription: Share this URL with your SAML provider as the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS).
setupUrlPending: Save the provider first to generate these URLs.
authentikRedirectRegexDescription: Enable regex matching for redirect URIs in Authentik and use this pattern.
copyFailedDesc: Could not copy the URL to your clipboard.
copyUnsupported: Clipboard access is not available in this browser.
emailAttributeKeysHint: Comma-separated attribute names or URNs to search when resolving user emails (first match wins).
permissionSyncTtlMinutesHint: Roles are re-checked once this many minutes have passed since the last check, and when the session is refreshed (at most once per minute). Maximum 525600 (365 days).

permissionSync.description: By default, roles from this provider are only updated when a user signs in. Turn this on to re-check signed-in users' roles at the identity provider with their refresh token, so role changes take effect without a new sign-in.

requirements.title: Check your identity provider before turning this on
requirements.refreshToken: The provider must issue refresh tokens for this client. Some providers only do so when the offline_access scope is requested. Logins without a refresh token are never re-synced; Attraccess logs a warning for them.
requirements.tokenLifetime: Refresh tokens must stay valid for longer than the interval. With Keycloak, set the realm's SSO Session Idle (30 minutes by default) and SSO Session Max to at least the interval, or request offline_access. Otherwise every user is signed out at their first re-sync.
requirements.rejection: If the provider rejects a refresh token, for example because the user was disabled or their provider session ended, that user's Attraccess session ends immediately.
requirements.existingSessions: Only sessions started on this Attraccess version or later can be re-synced. Users who signed in before the update must sign in once more.

samlProvisioningSecretHint: Used to authorize SAML provisioning calls (logout, delete, permissions). Leave blank to keep existing secret.
roleMappingsHint: Map your identity provider’s groups or roles to Attraccess roles: users get a mapped role when they log in with the listed IdP group/role value, and lose it again when the value disappears from their IdP account. Manually assigned roles are never touched.
roleMappingsEmpty: No role mappings configured yet. Use “Add mapping” to create one.
roleMappingsDrawerDescription: Pick an Attraccess role and enter the identity provider group or role value that should grant it.
noProviders: No SSO providers found. Create one to get started.
oidcLogoutHint: Empty endpoints use trusted issuer discovery. Signing algorithms default to RS256. HTTPS is required except for local development.
samlLogoutHint: Single Logout requires the IdP entity ID, logout URL, and Service Provider signing certificate and private key. Every logout message must be signed.
logoutRegistrationHint: Register these exact URLs at the provider. Enable signed back-channel notifications for reliable delivery. Front-channel notifications with session ID are supported; cookie-only notifications may be blocked by browser privacy settings.
samlLogoutRegistrationHint: Register this URL for HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST Single Logout. Attraccess sends signed Redirect messages. Configure the IdP signing certificate and trust the Attraccess signing certificate.
